prisoners.name: Bajun Dhunjisha Mavalwalla II
prisoners.description: Bajun Dhunjisha Mavalwalla II was one of nine people federally arrested on July 15, 2025 over the June 11 protest that blocked vehicles transporting ICE detainees from the Spokane Homeland Security office. Prosecutors charged the group with conspiracy to impede or injure federal officers.
prisoners.body: Verified detail sources (October 9, 2026, continued review): The Spokesman-Review’s January 10, 2026 interview and on-scene reporting uses he/him and explicitly identifies Bajun Mavalwalla II as the son of the older candidate Bajun Mavalwalla. The article matches the federal protest defendant. His father’s campaign and professional biographies are not treated as the son’s records; no birthdate or race is inferred. Source 1.

cases.charges: Federal conspiracy to impede or injure officers arising from the June 11, 2025 Spokane ICE-office protest.
cases.sentence: Released on conditions after the July 15, 2025 initial appearance.
